changes: Notes expanded: final '-na' in 'hemā〇krana' read as Newari ergative suffix (Hemākara-na), supporting the reading Hemākara; '〇' is a string-hole/space mark, not a lost akṣara
Affiliation clarified: the scribe's house is on the south side of the Raraṃkṛtavihāra, which belongs to the (Tarumura) Mahāvihāra
Date checked: NS 892 + 880 gives 1772 CE for Āśvina; buddhavāra is Wednesday

persons.name: Hemākara
persons.residence: Sayava tola; house south of Raraṃkṛtavihāra

notes: The scribe's name is written 'śrīhemā〇krana'. '〇' is probably a string-hole space and not a lost character, and the final '-na' is likely the Newari ergative ending, so the name reads Hemākara (Hemākara-na likhyate). The place is unclear. 'sayava tolake' is a locality (tola) in Newari locative. '(tarumura)' is the cataloguer's uncertain reading of the mahāvihāra's name. 'raraṃkṛtavihāra' may be corrupt. 'dakṣanadisagṛha' means a house on the south side (dakṣiṇadiśā). The city is not identified. The year is in NS with no conflicting era. Thvakuhnu sidhu juro (Newari) means 'completed on this day'.
